title: nan
authors: Milijas R.; Markovic L.; Ivanovic A.; Petric F.; Bogdan S.
key_contribution: Presents an empirical comparison of LiDAR SLAM algorithms (Cartographer, LOAM, HDL graph SLAM) integrated as pose feedback in a UAV flight control loop.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using LiDAR_SLAM to ensure precise positioning.
